attributes.board_name: New Mexico Board of Veterinary Medicine

rules.accepted_credit_types: Seminars, short courses or scientific programs approved by RACE, AVMA, NAVTA, or sponsored by a veterinary medical association, veterinary organization, university, or by the board
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE starts with the next full licensure year after graduation.
rules.carryover: Up to 8 excess hours may be carried forward to the next licensing year.
rules.notes: Registered veterinary technicians: 8 hours per calendar year (January–December); licenses expire December 31. Non-contact/online hours must be designed for vet techs, max half. Board update: all CE hours may be taken online/virtually through Dec 31, 2026.
